narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Infosys has a well-documented pattern of sandbagging guidance — setting conservative targets then beating them. Revenue guidance is raised every quarter. The outlier is large-deal TCV, where management's bullish commentary oversells the pipeline relative to recognised revenue conversion. Margin guidance is hit consistently.

guided.guidance: 4-6% YoY in constant currency for FY27

delivered.actual: 3.8% YoY CC — below low end of 4-6% band

quarters.commentary: Unusual miss for Infosys — typically guides conservatively. Management cited delayed decision-making in BFSI clients and ramp-down of two mega-deals. Guidance maintained despite the miss, suggesting they view it as a timing issue, not structural.

Classic Infosys playbook: raise guidance mid-year then beat it. This is the third consecutive year of this pattern. Analysts have largely priced in this sandbagging tendency — the upside surprise is smaller each time.

guided.guidance: Margins to expand 50-80bps H2 vs H1 on pyramid optimisation

delivered.actual: 5.1% YoY CC — already above guidance mid-point
22.1% — expanded 90bps vs H1 avg, beat guidance

quarters.commentary: Strong quarter drove the guidance raise. Margin expansion came from hiring freeze residual effects and favourable currency. Management admitted some of the margin benefit was 'one-time in nature' — worth watching if it sustains.

guided.guidance: Pipeline remains healthy at $4B+ per quarter

delivered.actual: 4.4% YoY CC — massive beat, guidance raised to 3-5%

quarters.commentary: This was the quarter that confirmed FY26 would be a recovery year. Initial 1-3% guidance looked overly conservative even when issued. Management's pattern of low-balling then beating is now well-understood by the market.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Infosys systematically under-promises and over-delivers on revenue growth — guidance is raised almost every quarter. Margin guidance is reliable. The one area where credibility slips is large-deal TCV commentary, where management's bullish tone doesn't always convert to recognised revenue in the expected timeframe.

bull_bear.bull: Highest ROCE in Indian IT at 38%. Net-cash balance sheet. AI-led services pivot (Topaz platform) gaining traction — 60% of large deals now have an AI component. Free cash flow conversion >80%. Dividend yield ~2.5% provides downside protection. Attrition at multi-year lows gives cost stability.
bull_bear.bear: Growth capped at 4-6% CC — industry structural slowdown as clients optimise discretionary spend. AI could cannibalise existing services revenue faster than new AI-native revenue scales. Premium PE (28×) leaves no room for disappointment. Management depth risk — three CEO transitions in 5 years has disrupted strategic continuity.
